full_prompt_en: A square mural-like painting crops into a monumental red-brown face so closely that one large amber eye, a heavy brow, the nose, and curling lower facial forms fill the frame. The eye sits above center-left, ringed by concentric warm ochre and deep crimson bands; its dark pupil and small pale highlight make it the central point of attention. A thick black brow sweeps across the top, pressed against angular red planes of the forehead. The bridge of the nose descends along the right side as a broad lit ridge, with a rounded nostril and deep black recess near the lower middle. On the left, a bold spiral of reddish flesh or stylized hair curves inward, and another dark curling shape follows the lower edge. These exaggerated arcs interlock with sharp facets, making the face feel carved or constructed rather than softly naturalistic. The entire background is swallowed by the enlarged facial structure, though thin horizontal and vertical seams crossing the image suggest a painted wall or paneled carrier beneath the artwork. Color remains concentrated in burnt orange, brick red, ochre, and black, with small ivory crescents around the eye. Short brushed and scratched marks are visible within the broader planes, giving the surface a dry, roughened quality. Directional warm light seems to strike the high ridges from above and left, while the grooves beneath the brow, around the eye, and beside the nose settle into dense charcoal shadow. The force of the shading gives the flat carrier a powerful illusion of swelling volume. The overall composition is confrontational and compressed, turning an incomplete face into a rhythmic arrangement of staring eye, spirals, and heavy shadowed relief.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形壁画般绘画极近距离裁切一张巨大红棕色面孔，使一只大琥珀色眼睛、粗重眉弓、鼻子和卷曲的下方面部形体填满画幅。眼睛位于中央偏左上方，周围环绕同心的暖赭色和深绯红带；深色瞳孔与小片浅色高光使它成为注意力中心。厚黑眉弓横扫上方，压在额部棱角分明的红色平面上。鼻梁沿右侧以宽阔受光脊线向下延伸，下方中央附近有圆润鼻翼和深黑凹处。左侧，一道粗大的红色肉面或程式化毛发螺旋向内卷，另一道深色卷形沿下画边延伸。这些夸张弧形与尖锐折面交锁，使面孔显得像雕刻或构筑而成，而非柔和的自然主义。背景完全被放大的面部结构吞没，不过贯穿画面的细横竖接缝暗示艺术品下方是墙面或分板载体。色彩集中在焦橙、砖红、赭色和黑色，眼周有少量象牙色弯月形亮部。宽阔平面内部可见短小刷痕与擦划痕迹，令表面干涩、粗糙。方向明确的暖光似从左上照到高起的脊面，眉下、眼周及鼻侧沟槽则沉入浓重炭色阴影。强烈明暗使平面载体呈现隆起体积的错觉。整体构图具有逼人的压迫感，把不完整面容化成凝视的眼、螺旋和厚重阴影浮雕的节奏排列。
style_prompt_en: The mural-like image builds monumental volume from interlocking red and ochre planes, thick black grooves, and tight spiraling contours. Warm highlights sit on raised ridges, while recesses drop quickly into charcoal, producing a carved-relief effect on a visibly rough, seamed surface. Broad shapes carry the force of the design; small scratched and brushed marks animate their interiors without softening the edges. The palette stays concentrated in brick red, burnt orange, ochre, and black, with tiny pale highlights used as sharp focal points. Close cropping removes environmental depth and turns curved and angular forms into a dense repeating rhythm. The overall finish is tactile, dramatic, and physically imposing, with chiaroscuro and contour doing more work than fine descriptive detail.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅壁画般图像用交锁的红色和赭色平面、粗黑沟槽与紧密螺旋轮廓建立宏大的体积。暖色高光落在凸起脊面，凹处迅速跌入炭黑，使带接缝的可见粗糙表面呈现雕刻浮雕效果。宽阔形状承担设计力量，内部细小擦划和刷痕令它们活跃，却不柔化边缘。色盘集中在砖红、焦橙、赭色与黑色，极少量浅亮部用作锐利焦点。近距离裁切移除环境纵深，把弧形与折角形体变成浓密重复的节奏。整体完成面可触、戏剧化且具有物理压迫感，明暗和轮廓比细微描写承担更多作用。
theme_en: An intense close-up of one eye and curling facial forms in a red-brown mural
theme_zh: 红棕壁画中一只眼睛与卷曲面部形体的强烈近景
name: David Alfaro Siqueiros
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
